author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Get exclusive videos & early access on my Patreon: http://patreon.com/RyanGeorge

A one-hour deep dive into everything wrong with the internet right now: Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube, and Snapchat.

The internet used to be pretty good and then something happened. In this compilation I go through all of it: Google burying real results under ads and AI that recommends eating rocks, Facebook overrun by AI slop and like-farming scams, the absolute lunatics of LinkedIn Part 2, Reddit's very passionate tree communities, YouTube Playables (yes that's a thing), and Snapchat Spotlight which has somehow gotten so much worse since the last time I checked. I did not enjoy most of this research. I did it for you.
